items.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued August 28 at 12:58PM AKDT until August 29 at 4:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:

items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued August 28 at 9:01AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
Rainfall across much of the Central Interior, including the
Fairbanks North Star Borough becomes more scattered and showery in
the afternoon. As this happens drier air brings gusty west-
southwest winds to the area Friday evening. Gusts in the 25 to 35
mph range are expected to continue through Saturday. Overnight

items.headline: High Wind Warning issued August 28 at 5:50AM AKDT until August 28 at 10:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...South winds 35 to 45 mph with gusts up to 70 mph.

* WHERE...Eastern Alaska Range North of Trims Camp.

* WHEN...Until 10 PM AKDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Wind gusts have likely peaked this morning,
with gusts of 70 mph observed. Winds will gradually weaken
throughout the day.
items.areas: Eastern Alaska Range North of Trims Camp
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued August 28 at 5:00AM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
Strong southeasterly winds are expected to increase this morning
and continue through this evening before diminishing late
tonight. The strongest winds are expected between 8 AM and 6 PM
today. Periods of rain will accompany the strong winds through
much of the day.

South and West Anchorage (along Turnagain Arm): Winds 20 to 30
mph with gusts 35 to 45 mph. Isolated gusts to 50 mph possible.

Anchorage Hillside: Winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts 40 to 55 mph.
